lines.en: Would you like to learn about eastern box turtles?
What would you like to say?
: {i}Hi, Kaori. Please teach me about whatever that thing is.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗨，Kaori。请教我那到底是什么东西。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}this is the eastern box turtle its scientific name is terrapene carolina and it is a reptile{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是东部箱龟 它的学名是 terrapene carolina 它是爬行动物{/i}

lines.en: : {i}the eastern box turtle is one of the most common turtles human beings encounter in the wild and they normally grow to around six inches{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}东部箱龟是人类在野外最常遇到的龟之一 它们一般长到六英寸左右{/i}

lines.en: : {i}there are many different types of box turtles and they all come in different colors what is your favorite color friend i bet it is blue{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}箱龟有很多不同的种类 而且颜色都各不相同 朋友你最喜欢什么颜色 我打赌是蓝色{/i}

lines.en: : {i}i knew it anyway you can find the eastern box turtle near ponds and rivers and they normally like warm weather but not too hot because then they will get hot{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我就知道 总之你可以在池塘和河边找到东部箱龟 它们通常喜欢暖和的天气 但不能太热 不然它们就会变热{/i}

lines.en: : {i}eastern box turtles are omnivores like human beings and eat all sorts of things like human beings but not human beings because they are too large{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}东部箱龟和人类一样是杂食动物 吃各种各样的东西 跟人类一样 但不吃人类 因为人类太大了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}like many other hard circle lizards the eastern box turtle will retract its limbs into its shell in order to protect itself kind of like a horse if horses could do that{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}像许多其他硬壳圆蜥蜴一样 东部箱龟会把四肢缩进壳里来保护自己 有点像马 如果马也能那样的话{/i}

lines.en: : {i}did you know that after breeding the female terrapene carolina can lay eggs for up to four years afterward thats crazy what if humans could egg{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗 交配过后 雌性 terrapene carolina 能在之后长达四年的时间里一直下蛋 太疯狂了 要是人类也能下蛋会怎样{/i}

lines.en: : {i}they can also live up to one hundred years old on many occassions and like land more than pretty much any other turtle are you learning friend are you having fun{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它们在很多情况下还能活到一百岁 而且比几乎任何其他龟都喜欢陆地 朋友你在学吗 你开心吗{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes, Kaori. I am having a blast.{/i}
: {i}hooray for learning and hooray for fun we should adopt an eastern box turtle and name him franklin like the popular tv show franklin about a turtle named franklin do you remember that show{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为学习欢呼 为开心欢呼 我们应该养一只东部箱龟 给它取名叫富兰克林 就像那部很受欢迎的电视节目《富兰克林》 讲的就是一只叫富兰克林的乌龟 你还记得那部剧吗{/i}

lines.en: : {i}anyway i hope you enjoyed the turtle lesson and that you will consider obtaining one as a human pet in the future because they are very friendly and cuddly but not so cuddly because shell{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之我希望你喜欢这堂龟课 也希望你在未来会考虑养一只当人类宠物 因为它们非常友好又爱抱抱 但也不算太爱抱抱 因为有壳{/i}

lines.en: : {i}remember to always get a captive bred pet if it is an option because we do not want to disturb the ecosystem anyway burger time goodbye friend i love you but i mean friend love hello{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}记得如果可以的话 一定要选人工繁殖的宠物 因为我们不想破坏生态系统 总之 汉堡时间 再见朋友 我爱你 但我是说朋友那种爱 你好{/i}
